name: Proxmox Cluster Health
description: The whole Proxmox cluster at a glance: quorum, each node's CPU, RAM and system disk, storage pools, VMs and containers running, and the alarms active now (as on the Control Panel's Proxmox tab). Read-only.
requires: Proxmox VE API token (PROXMOX_TOKEN_ID, or PROXMOX_API_TOKEN)
